## 🌟 Summary
YOLO models can now be exported to Apple Core AI format from x86_64 Linux, making Linux servers and CI environments useful for preparing models for Apple devices.

## 📊 Key Changes
- 🍎 **Core AI export on Linux:** Export `.aimodel` files on x86_64 Linux as well as Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later. The exported models target iOS 27 and macOS 27; **running them still requires Apple hardware**.
- 🔧 **Updated Core AI compatibility:** Supports `coreai-torch` 0.4.3, which performs optimization during conversion. The dependency now supports Python 3.11–3.14.
- 📈 **Clearer benchmarks:** Linux can report Core AI export results, while inference is correctly skipped because it requires macOS.
- 🛠️ **More reliable exports:** PyTorch functions patched for certain ONNX exports are now restored even when an export fails, preventing unexpected effects on later operations in the same process.
- 🐳 **Lean­er Docker images:** Docker builds avoid retaining package-install caches and remove bundled PyTorch test files, reducing image contents without removing needed runtime tools.

## 🎯 Purpose & Impact
- 🌐 Teams can build Apple-targeted models in Linux-based cloud, server, and CI workflows instead of needing a Mac for export.
- 📱 Apple hardware is still required to run `.aimodel` files, and Core ML remains a separate option.
- ✅ Export failures are less likely to leave a Python process in a modified state, while smaller Docker images use less storage and are quicker to distribute.

## What's Changed
* Skip the uv cache and torch test files in Docker images, and fix Core AI export by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26326
* Support coreai-torch 0.4.3, which removed `AIProgram.optimize()` by @cdeil in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26327
* Restore PyTorch functions after failed exports by @Nikhi00718 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26325
* `ultralytics 8.4.163` Export Apple Core AI models on Linux by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26333


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/compare/v8.4.162...v8.4.163

summary:
## Summary

Trackers 2.6.1 fixes tracker output and mask lifecycle edge cases, restores fractional coordinates in integer-input box conversion, and reads numbered image frames in temporal order. It also prevents malformed boxes from receiving a spurious GIoU bonus and repairs URLs generated by versioned documentation deployment. The patch updates the optional detection dependency floor and refreshes the lockfile and release tooling through #599; users of OC-SORT output, integer box conversion, or the detection extra should review the migration guidance below.

## Highlights

- **OC-SORT returns every supplied detection:** a detection below `high_conf_det_threshold` now appears in `update()` output with `tracker_id=-1` instead of disappearing. The row remains in the returned detections, though output order can differ from input order ([#566](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/566)).
- **McByte delivers mask removals after interruptions:** removal notifications remain queued across skipped frames, duplicate timestamps, and recoverable CUDA out-of-memory failures, including tracks pruned early during timestamp updates ([#568](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/568)).
- **Input and scoring edge cases behave predictably:** image files such as `2.jpg` precede `10.jpg`, integer box decoding retains fractional coordinates, and inverted boxes cannot gain an invalid positive GIoU bonus ([#558](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/558), [#557](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/557), [#589](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/589)).

## Migration guide

- **OC-SORT output:** if downstream code assumed low-confidence detections were absent, filter detections before `update()` when `confidence` is available, or filter the returned rows by confidence. Low-confidence rows have `tracker_id=-1`; detections without confidence remain eligible for association regardless of the threshold. Do not rely on output row order matching input order.
- **Integer-input box conversion:** `xcycsr_to_xyxy` now promotes integer arrays to `float64` before arithmetic for single boxes and batches, preserving fractional coordinates and avoiding integer-product overflow. Code requiring integer boxes should round or cast the decoded array explicitly; floating-point input retains its dtype, including `float16`.
- **Detection extra:** `trackers[detection]` now requires `inference-models>=0.36.0`; update an older installed detection stack when upgrading. The final 2.6.1 lock resolves it to `0.37.0`.

No other public API removal or new deprecation is present in this release range.

## Notable changes

### Fixed

- **McByte and Kalman state:** mask-removal delivery is durable, while BoT-SORT and McByte refresh process noise for prediction and measurement noise for update instead of rebuilding the unused matrix ([#568](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/568), [#567](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/567)).
- **OC-SORT output, box conversion, image input, and GIoU:** the output and numeric corrections described above are covered by regression tests ([#566](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/566), [#557](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/557), [#558](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/558), [#589](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/589)).
- **Versioned documentation URLs:** Mike-deployed canonical, Open Graph, structured-data, and sitemap URLs target the `/latest/` alias instead of `/latest/2.6.0/` ([#582](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/582)).

### Changed

- **Optional detection dependency:** raised the `inference-models` minimum from `0.19.0` to `0.36.0` for the detection extra ([#592](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/592)).
- **Dependency lock:** refreshed the applicable 2.6 dependency graph. The final lock contains `cryptography 50.0.0`, `hydra-core 1.3.4`, `optuna 5.0.0`, `transformers 5.15.1`, and `uv 0.12.13`. These are dependency updates, with no specific security fix claimed ([#537](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/537), [#542](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/542), [#546](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/546), [#570](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/570), [#575](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/575), [#581](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/581), [#588](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/588), [#591](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/591), [#592](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/592), [#599](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/599)).
- **Release tooling:** updated GitHub Actions and pre-commit pins, moved pre-commit autoupdates to monthly, and ignored local `benchmarks/` output ([#544](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/544), [#550](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/550), [#590](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/590), [#593](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/593), 1770d65929dc6bbab9639ddc3301104405610c59, 330a9ee42a32e40a7b9b10cdf4a89eec32d5b8fe).

### Documentation

- Synchronized McByte benchmark and tracker comparison tables, tracker defaults, quickstart and evaluation guidance, dataset details, README terminology, search-result titles, and video poster frames with the 2.6 release layout ([#539](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/539), [#547](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/547), [#555](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/555), [#564](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/564), [#583](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/583), [#585](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/585), [#587](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/pull/587)).

## Contributors

- **Jesús Royeth** (@JESUSROYETH, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jesusroyeth/)) — fixed OC-SORT low-confidence output and McByte mask cleanup; corrected Kalman noise refresh.
- **Alexander Bodner** (@AlexBodner, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexanderbodner/)) — fixed box conversion, image-directory ordering, and documentation canonical URLs; improved release documentation.
- **Mahathir Mohammad Shuvo** (@MahathirMohammadShuvo, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mahathir-mohammad-shuvo)) — fixed GIoU scoring for malformed boxes.
- **Jirka Borovec** (@Borda, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jirka-borovec))) — corrected tracker documentation and McByte summaries; updated pre-commit configuration and contributed to tracker fixes.
- **Tomasz Stanczyk** (@tstanczyk95, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tomasz-stanczyk/))) — corrected converter dtype handling after review and adapted release-branch documentation, dependency lock updates, and pre-commit changes.

*Automated contributions: @claude[bot], @dependabot[bot], @pre-commit-ci[bot], Claude Fable 5, Claude Opus 5, Copilot Autofix powered by AI, Cursor, OpenAI Codex*

**Full changelog:** [2.6.0 to 2.6.1](https://github.com/roboflow/trackers/compare/2.6.0...3666546420b0fd564c8e63157a6621efffdfa01a).
